historical_record.description: The Recreation Commission engaged William G. Merchant, architect, to plan a recreation area with a recreation building and facilities at Pine Lake, west of 25th Avenue and Crestlake Drive.

The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract for a field house, access road, parking and camp areas at Pine Lake to Martinelli Construction Co. at $75,694, after rejecting an August round of bids as over budget.
